summary.text: Tracy Quint is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 8 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A nurse and business owner, she has served in the Maine House since 2020.

paragraphs.text: Tracy Quint lives in Hodgdon, Maine, and earned a degree in nursing in 1997.
Her career experience includes owning a business and working as a nurse.
Quint first won a seat in the Maine House in 2020, when she defeated Kathryn Harnish in District 144, and she won District 8 in 2022 and 2024.
She served on the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee in 2021-2022 and on the Taxation Committee in 2023-2024.
